name: Rebecca Coltorti
description: Rebecca’s design stems from the desire to express her aesthetic as an artist. She works with several techniques but she is known for mixing collage and paint, so, for her, the design was an exciting challenge to find the right key to transpose her style into a simple drawn graphic that would meet the technical needs of the FES Watch U. Rebecca’s work is mostly based on textures, and her favourites to use are the animal ones. She therefore decided to paint a patchwork with them taking inspiration directly from her artworks. For the watch face, Rebecca opted for a minimal design and elegant numbers to achieve a bold and feminine look.
